Name: Jorts and Jean Stardew Valley Expanded Compatibility Patch (Removes plank from SVE mountain path)
Author: glymr
Description:
This is a very silly little mod that removes the plank that appears on the mountain path when both "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]" and "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url]" mods are installed. Put it in your mod folder and it will auto-detect if both mods are installed and then, BOOM! PLANK-B-GONE!

Yes, it works with re-colors. I included a picture with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor installed to show that it works. ^_^

If either "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean[/url]" or "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]" add a fix for this small visual issue, I'll be happy to remove this mod forever.

In the meantime, I'll take all the endorsements I can get! (That was a joke. This is a silly little nothing mod. It does not deserve your endorsement. Others deserve endorsements far more - particularly the two mods it is creating compatibility for. PLEASE go and endorse them if you like this one. :)

I've finally gone ahead and opted in for donation points for this mod, since it still works in 1.6 and is still popular. I wanted to donate them to the same charity as tiakall chose for the original Jorts and Jean, but United Farm Workers is no longer an option. I have therefore chosen to donate all donation points earned from this mod to Doctors Without Borders, a charity I have personally donated to before and which I has a mission I support.
